To resolve these compilation errors, you need to ensure that the `commons-compress` dependency is included in your `pom.xml` file with a version that contains the required packages. - `org.apache.commons.compress.compressors`
- `org.apache.commons.compress.compressors.bzip2`
- `org.apache.commons.compress.compressors.lzma`

These errors indicate that the required classes for handling compression (BZIP2 and LZMA) are not available in the classpath, which is likely due to a missing or incorrect version of the `commons-compress` dependency.

### How to Fix the Errors

To resolve these compilation errors, you need to ensure that the `commons-compress` dependency is included in your `pom.xml` file with a version that contains the required packages. Based on the available versions, I recommend using version `1.28.0`, as it is the latest stable version and should include the necessary classes.

Here is the suggested dependency to add to your `pom.xml`:

```xml
<dependency>
    <groupId>org.apache.commons</groupId>
    <artifactId>commons-compress</artifactId>
    <version>1.28.0</version>
</dependency>
```

If you encounter issues with this version, you may also consider downgrading to `1.27.0` or `1.26.0`, as they are also stable versions that may contain the required classes.

By adding the correct version of the `commons-compress` dependency to your project, you should be able to resolve the compilation errors and successfully build your project.
